observations: Dominant pattern: numbers are computed internal results (25/40) — substrate/cluster counts, QAP enrichments, AUROC/ARI/recall — or author-stipulated params (9/40: FDR q, coverage gates, d_g windows, seed offsets). Almost all are precise, not handwavy (1/40). Provenance is real but rarely paragraph-local: 38/40 are covered either by a task-naming title/frontmatter (11) or a task/dataset/citation reference elsewhere in the doc (27), yet para_has_any_anchor is false for every record — so a paragraph-scoped lint is nearly all false positives here. A better check should (a) resolve doc-level frontmatter task_links/related and inline tXXX/cite:/dataset: refs before flagging, (b) recognize config.yaml knobs, and (c) reserve genuine signal for bare stipulated thresholds defined in-doc with no grounding (e.g. the 60% gate) and rhetorical round numbers.
